messages:
alex: quick check — we're aiming to add capacity for a customer dedicated pool in us-west1 next month. need ~8 x A100 80GB (persistent) for an initial bump, plus room to burst 4 more. can infra confirm vendor availability and ETA?

marta: which vendors are we preferring for this? coreweave/lambda/equinix? also do we have a procurement PO ready or should i start the PO flow? :thinking_face:

samir: CoreWeave quoted us 2–3 week lead on new reserved gear last quarter. Lambda had faster spot-ish options but limited 80GB inventory. equinix offers baremetal; procurement lead time was longer. i can ping coreweave now.

alex: thanks. customer wants predictable throughput -> prefer reserved CoreWeave if they can commit. budget ok for reserved for 6mo. please verify whether we can get guaranteed allocation. also need to know if GCP/AWS quotas need bump for fallback pool (we route to cloud if vendor drops).

devin: left a quota request for GCP compute region us-west1 for GPUs yesterday (ticket GCQ-4821). added note: fallback capacity for redwood-dedicated-cust-42. Status: pending.

marta: ok i'll open supplier PO if coreweave can commit in <=3w. samir — ping vendor and ask for: guaranteed allocation, billing cadence, cancellation terms, and whether they provide nvidia driver/stack managed or we bring our own.

samir: pinged CoreWeave — summary from sales: "can reserve 8x A100-80GB within 10–14 business days pending credit/PO. burst buffer 4x best-effort within week depending on region. monthly billing with 30d cancellation." forwarded the email to procurement.

alex: perfect. devin — if they give 10–14 business days, can we schedule a canary rollout on week 3? planning 10% traffic to the dedicated pool first. also what's the infra work to wire up routing policy?

devin: routing policy is already plumbed in RDW router service but we need to add new pool config + SLO mapping. rough tasks: 1) add pool entry + model variants, 2) update smart routing policy to prefer dedicated then fallback, 3) add perf tests and synthetic traffic job. estimate 2 engineer-days + 1 day for e2e tests.

marta: procurement asked for contract term suggestions — alex any constraints? we prefer month-to-month with 30d cancel but the customer wants a 6mo commitment on our end. we can sign a 6mo with pass-through billing to customer.

alex: prefer 6mo to match customer SLA. ok with monthly billing from vendor, redwood commits 6mo to customer only. ensure cancellation terms allow for migration to cloud with 30d notice.

samir: vendor replied with sample PO terms and asked for billing entity and start date. they also require a 50% deposit for reserved hardware.

marta: deposit is standard. i'll prepare draft PO and share for legal. cc @alex.

ops-bot: Reservation created: coreweave-resv-185000 — placeholder (capacity pending confirmation). :white_check_mark:

alex: thanks @ops-bot. devin, can you add temporary routing entry to use the placeholder pool but mark it as drain=false so we can smoke test once hardware shows up? keep canary at 1% until we validate latency/cost.

devin: will do. i'll also wire a metric alert if average p95 latency > 150ms for the canary.

samir: vendor follow-up: if deposit signed today we can aim for start date 2028-05-10 (10 business days). they requested counter-signed PO by EOD Friday.

marta: i'll try to get draft to legal this morning. alex can you approve the counterparty and estimate? also confirm we can absorb the 50% deposit on the card?

alex: approve. finance already pre-approved a temporary card for vendor deposits under vendor-exceptions. i'll reply to procurement to proceed. :thumbsup:

devin: small ops note — we should request IPMI/redfish access and GPU driver image from CoreWeave to prebuild our AMI/container so we can reduce onboarding time. add to vendor checklist.

samir: added to checklist. vendor confirmed remote management and custom image support.

marta: quick ask — is there any GCP quota we still need to escalate as fallback? devin you mentioned GCQ-4821 — should i cc sales-eng so they can pause traffic until fallback is guaranteed?

devin: GCQ-4821 is still pending; i bumped priority to P2. if coreweave timelines slip we may open AWS quota as well. i can open AWS limit request today (ticket AWS-Q-921) — that'll give us two fallback providers.

alex: ok do both. keep me posted if any timeline slips.

samir: vendor just sent final confirmation of inventory. they'll prepare final PO after we submit deposit. ETA still 10 business days.

marta: sending draft PO to legal now. thanks all.

alex: awesome — appreciate the quick turn. i'll message customer with tentative 2028-05-10 start and 10% canary. :rocket:
